test_moolib_rpc_pickle: test that moolib.Rpc correctly pickles complex nested objects across client-server sync calls
create_rpc_host: create an moolib.Rpc host that listens on an address and defines callable methods
create_rpc_client: create an moolib.Rpc client that connects to a host and calls remote methods synchronously
define_rpc_method: define a named RPC method on the host that accepts and returns pickled objects
run_rpc_sync_call: run a synchronous RPC call from client to host passing a custom class instance
